info.title: College CMS API
info.description: REST API for the College CMS. Public endpoints return published/active content only. Admin endpoints require a bearer token with the editor or admin role. Successful responses use `{ data }` (lists add `{ meta }`); errors use `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`. Requests beyond the per-IP rate-limit window return 429 with code `rate_limited` and a `Retry-After` header (see `#/components/responses/RateLimited`).

get.description: SSE stream used by the frontend for live refresh. On connect it sends `retry: 3000` and an `event: ready` frame, then an `event: content` frame (`{ entity, action, at }`) after every successful admin mutation. A `: heartbeat` comment is written every `SSE_HEARTBEAT_MS` (default 25000 ms). No authentication; the payload never includes content data. Responds 503 with `internal_error` when `SSE_MAX_CLIENTS` connected clients are already open.

bearerAuth.description: ADMIN_TOKEN grants the admin role; EDITOR_TOKEN grants the editor role. Roles are derived server-side from the token.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not allowed (e.g. editor deleting)

Conflict.description: Unique constraint conflict or resource in use

AdminAcademicDetails.description: Stream with academic details (may be null)

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded for this client IP in the current window. Every endpoint can return this; retry after `Retry-After` seconds.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the current rate-limit window resets

mediaId.description: Required for image blocks; must reference an existing media row

items.description: Gallery blocks only; replaces all gallery items when present

blocks.description: Replaces all blocks for the page inside a transaction

degreeLevelId.description: Must be provided together with streamId, and the pair must exist in degree_level_streams

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL or a root-relative path starting with /
